pets.name: 浪花豚
pets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production growth animation sprite atlas for a companion app.
Create ONE portrait PNG, ideally 2048x2560 pixels, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS = TWENTY full-body animal frames. Equal rectangular grid cells. No written numbers, text, labels, lines, borders or checkerboard. Genuine transparent alpha background. No floor or cast shadows.
Every row is a different age of the SAME animal. Within each row repeat that age for a consistent four-frame idle animation: column 1 relaxed eyes open, column 2 tiny inhale/motion, column 3 blink at motion peak, column 4 eyes reopened returning to initial pose. Tiny movement only. Fixed camera, viewing direction, soft studio key and cool rim lighting across all twenty frames. Animal silhouette remains entirely inside the central 75% of each cell, at least 15% empty transparent separation between adjacent animals, never clipped.
Premium polished pre-rendered 3D animation-film animal, sophisticated appealing anatomy and tactile appropriate skin texture. Not primitive spheres, not flat illustration, not plastic. No clothing or crowns. The five age rows MUST change actual head-to-body ratio, appendage length, body silhouette, face anatomy and natural material structure. DO NOT merely scale one model or add accessories. Adult eyes are proportionally smaller; adults look anatomically grown and elegant, while retaining friendliness. Make top and bottom rows unmistakably different ages even if resized to same height.
Subject: one silver-blue bottlenose dolphin with white belly, friendly expressive teal eyes, horizontal swimming pose facing upper right, gentle curve from rostrum through tail. All fins and both tail flukes visible in every frame. Three-quarter side view with near side exposed. Refined silvery skin and subtle aqua edge light, no extraneous glows.
Age rows, mandatory distinct anatomy:
Row 1 hatchling-like newborn calf: very round bulbous forehead, huge eye, extremely short stubby rostrum, plump short torso, tiny rounded dorsal and pectoral fins, short tail peduncle.
Row 2 young calf: rounded forehead and cheek, slightly longer rostrum, chubby but visibly elongated torso, short fins, small tail flukes.
Row 3 adolescent: long streamlined torso, head relatively smaller, distinct bottlenose beak, growing swept triangular dorsal fin and longer pectoral fins, narrow waist into tail.
Row 4 adult: elegant muscular long spindle body, adult forehead, longer distinct narrow rostrum, smaller eye, swept pointed fins, long slim tail peduncle and wide flukes.
Row 5 full-grown mature adult: longest robust streamlined torso and broad chest tapering into an elongated narrow tail peduncle, powerful wide flukes, well-defined swept fins, realistically proportioned small eye, subtly textured mature blue-grey skin. Retain graceful friendliness, no scars.
Within each row only slight up/down tail beat and a blink; same age and body proportions across four columns. Each entire dolphin including tail stays well inside its equal cell. No water, bubbles, decorations or reflections.
pets.layoutCorrectionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the provided existing growth animation sprite sheet of dolphin.
Change ONLY layout, scale within the grid and transparent gutters. Preserve its five clearly different age anatomies, exact species, colors, polished 3D style and four subtle animation poses per age.

Requested image size 2048 by 2560 pixels, so each invisible cell is 512 by 512 pixels. Absolute cell centers x=256,768,1280,1792 and y=256,768,1280,1792,2304. If output resolution differs, preserve this exact proportional equal grid.
Put exactly ONE complete animal at each cell center, all 20 centered individually. Shrink each complete silhouette until it fits within a maximum 320 by 320 pixel box at 2048x2560 resolution (62.5% of the cell's width and height). Every cell MUST therefore have at least 18.75% completely empty transparent margin on all four sides. Adults must be scaled down to satisfy identical cell occupancy limits: their maturity is shown by anatomy, NOT by taking more cell space.
Do not preserve the original compressed row spacing, or any overlap or touching between animals. Uniform top/bottom row spacing is CRITICAL. An empty invisible horizontal gutter approximately 180 pixels high must separate every row of silhouettes, including rows 4 and 5; equally generous vertical gutters separate columns.
Keep every tail, flipper, arm and tentacle tip fully intact. Do not crop any frame. No visible grid, no labels, no borders, no text, no shadow, no floor, no extra particles, no colored background and no checkerboard. Preserve the image's five distinct growth forms and four-column timing. Layout correction only.
